screens.title: Policy Request Edit
screens.description: Policy Request Edit. Intended Users is a checkbox Select List fed by a data connector. The Select All toggle is a synchronous watcher, not a calculated property, so the checkboxes stay editable. Select All checks every key stored in intendedUsersCatalog.

config.content:
Policy Request Edit

Intended Users lists the data connector rows as checkboxes. The Select All toggle at the end checks or clears every option.

On the Select List, choose the Intended Users data connector. Keep Render As = Checkbox, Allow Multiple Select on, and Value Type Returned = Single. Key is the stored id (usually id). Content is the label (usually fullname). Data Name is the array inside the connector response (usually data).

Select All does not read the connector by itself. The same array must also be in intendedUsersCatalog. Add a Data Connector watcher, turn on Run on screen load, and map the response array to intendedUsersCatalog. After import, assign a Run Script user to PRE - Select All Intended Users.

Do not bind intendedUsers to a calculated property. ProcessMaker disables a control that is a calculated property, and a calc cannot see data connector options.

computed.name: Intended users catalog JSON
Intended users selection JSON

script.title: PRE - Select All Intended Users
script.description: Checks or clears every Intended Users option from intendedUsersCatalog.
script.code:
<?php
/*
 * Select All for the Intended Users checkbox list.
 *
 * A calculated property cannot do this job:
 * - Data connector options stay inside the Select List component.
 * - Binding intendedUsers to a calc disables the checkboxes.
 *
 * This watcher writes intendedUsers only. The control stays editable.
 * intendedUsersCatalog must be the same array the connector returns.
 * script configuration: {"valueKey":"id"}
 * Return value is stored in the watcher output variable intendedUsers.
 */

if (!function_exists('pre_decode_json_list')) {
    function pre_decode_json_list($value)
    {
        if (is_array($value)) {
            return $value;
        }
        if (!is_string($value) || $value === '') {
            return array();
        }
        $decodedText = html_entity_decode($value, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $decoded = json_decode($decodedText, true);
        return is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : array();
    }
}

if (!function_exists('pre_is_list')) {
    function pre_is_list($array)
    {
        if (!is_array($array)) {
            return false;
        }
        $index = 0;
        foreach ($array as $key => $unused) {
            if ($key !== $index) {
                return false;
            }
            $index++;
        }
        return true;
    }
}

$selectAllRaw = '';
if (isset($data['selectAllIntendedUsers'])) {
    $selectAllRaw = strtolower(trim((string) $data['selectAllIntendedUsers']));
}
$selectAll = in_array($selectAllRaw, array('1', 'true', 'yes', 'on'), true);

$valueKey = 'id';
if (isset($config['valueKey']) && is_string($config['valueKey']) && $config['valueKey'] !== '') {
    $valueKey = $config['valueKey'];
}

$catalog = pre_decode_json_list(isset($data['catalogJson']) ? $data['catalogJson'] : '[]');
if (!pre_is_list($catalog) && isset($catalog['data']) && pre_is_list($catalog['data'])) {
    $catalog = $catalog['data'];
}

$current = pre_decode_json_list(isset($data['currentJson']) ? $data['currentJson'] : '[]');

if (!$selectAll) {
    return array();
}

if (!pre_is_list($catalog) || count($catalog) === 0) {
    return $current;
}

$selected = array();
foreach ($catalog as $item) {
    if (is_array($item)) {
        if (array_key_exists($valueKey, $item) && $item[$valueKey] !== null && $item[$valueKey] !== '') {
            $selected[] = (string) $item[$valueKey];
        } elseif (array_key_exists('value', $item) && $item['value'] !== null && $item['value'] !== '') {
            $selected[] = (string) $item['value'];
        }
    } elseif (is_scalar($item) && $item !== '') {
        $selected[] = (string) $item;
    }
}

return array_values($selected);
